2011.pln: complaints only, too few sold to score
td: Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.

2012.why: It drew about half as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about electrical.
2012.pln: about half as many complaints as the average car
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.

2013.why: It drew a bit under half as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about electrical.
2013.pln: a bit under half as many complaints as the average car
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Stability control
The stability / traction warning light should stay off on the drive.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.

2014.why: It drew about two-thirds as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about electrical.
